entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Mr. Miller. I'm pulling up your order for the Aero Road Helmet now. So I can document this correctly, is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
The color is not what I expected. The box is unopened, of course.
I understand completely. Sometimes the shade can look quite different in person. Let me just check the return eligibility for you... one moment.
Okay, Mr. Miller, I see the delivery was 78 days ago. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days, so you are well within the window. We can definitely process this for you.
I will email a prepaid return label to you right now. For hygiene and rider safety reasons, we just have to confirm the helmet is completely unused and in its original packaging.
I already told you the box is unopened. Whatever.

I appreciate you confirming that. And Mr. Miller, as a thank you for being one of our VIP customers, I've upgraded your return shipping to be expedited at no cost to you. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund within 3 to 5 business days.
It's on its way to you now. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
